description.zh: 代码配置的ID。可以通过 CreateCodeSource、GetCodeSource 或者 ListCodeSources 这些接口获取。
description.en: The ID of the code source configuration. You can obtain the ID by calling the CreateCodeSource, GetCodeSource, or ListCodeSources operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun aiworkspace update-code-source --code-source-id code-2020000000000 --display-name MyCodeSource1 --description '用于XX的训练代码' --code-repo https://code.aliyun.com/000000 --code-branch dev --code-commit 3a600000 --code-repo-user-name demo-user --code-repo-access-token 000 --mount-path /root/code/code-source-1 --clone-type 0 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun aiworkspace PUT /api/v1/codesources/code-2020000000000 --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body {"MountPath":"/root/code/code-source-1","CodeRepo":"https://code.aliyun.com/000000","Description":"用于XX的训练代码","CodeRepoAccessToken":"000","CodeCommit":"3a600000","DisplayName":"MyCodeSource1","CodeBranch":"dev","CodeRepoUserName":"demo-user","CloneType":0}
